name: crisp-motion
description: Remotion source for crispstudio.in motion assets

scripts.render: remotion render Assemble out/assemble.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=24 --scale=0.8 && remotion render Crunch out/crunch.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=24 --scale=0.8 && remotion still Crunch ../assets/motion/crunch-poster.jpg --frame=0 --image-format=jpeg --scale=0.8 && ffmpeg -y -i out/assemble.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 29 -preset veryslow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an ../assets/motion/assemble.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -i out/crunch.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 29 -preset veryslow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an ../assets/motion/crunch.mp4
